seoTitle: About Aleah Hancock | Central Oregon Doula | Innate Doula Care
seoDescription: Meet Aleah Hancock, a state-certified doula, lactation counselor and car seat technician serving Central Oregon from Bend, and a two-time surrogate.
heading: Hi, I'm Aleah
lead: Pronounced uh-lee-uh. I am a full spectrum doula serving all of Central Oregon from my home in Bend.
paragraphs: I was born and raised in the California Bay Area, and life brought me to Bend after having my two kids in my early twenties. Before starting my own family I studied Early Childhood Education and Development, which is where my passion for supporting families began.

My path changed when someone close to me faced fertility challenges. That led me into the world of third-party reproduction and to being a surrogate twice. One of those journeys brought the gift of new life. The other brought lessons in resilience and compassion through loss. Both shape how I support families today.
I believe every experience is unique and deserves personalized, inclusive and non-judgmental care. My job is to help you feel confident in your choices.
When I am not doing birth work, you can find me being "Aunt Nutsy" to nine nieces and nephews, camping, hiking, dancing, playing board games, puzzling or reading.
